sloka: किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन्को वा ऽर्थः किं करोम्यहम् ।व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्तं प्रतिपाल्यताम् ।। ७.१०५.४ ॥
transliteration: kiṁ kāryaṁ brūhi bhagavanko vā 'rthaḥ kiṁ karomyaham ।vyagro hi rāghavo brahmanmuhūrtaṁ pratipālyatām ।। 7.105.4 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana asked, "O revered one, what is the task or purpose, and what shall I do, for Rama is indeed busy, O Brahmana, please wait for a moment."
